sources.role: SDL desktop engine, packed settings, input, save and path source
official project and supported desktop build evidence

paths.naming: Packed, #pragma-pack(1) s_savedata binary; includes SDL scancodes and display/audio settings. Exact size is conditional on build defines and version.

paths.path: Saves/default.cfg or Saves/<pak>.cfg keys[MAX_PLAYERS][MAX_BTN_NUM]; runtime SDL joystick enumeration is also consumed
paths.naming: Player 1 defaults are SDL scancodes (arrows, A/S/Z/X/D/F, Return, F12); current clearbuttons initializes players 2-4 to CONTROL_NONE even though joystick virtual-code constants are defined. No stable host-device identity is serialized.

paths.path: Saves/<pak>.sav, Saves/<pak>.hi and Saves/<pak>.s00..s99; recorded input uses the script-supplied filename under its path (Saves when empty)
paths.naming: .sav is game progress, .hi high scores, and .s00..s99 are script/global-variable save slots. Recorded input is a user-supplied filename (commonly .inp), not a fixed emulator sidecar; the built-in save names derive from the loaded .pak basename.

paths.path: No general OpenBOR desktop save-state file or numbered state-slot grammar is defined
paths.naming: The .inp recording and script/global-variable saves are not emulator snapshots.

linux-flatpak.reason: OpenBOR source supports desktop SDL builds but the pinned project does not publish an authoritative Flatpak manifest or sandbox persistence contract.

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not write OpenBOR settings bytes without the exact target executable build defines, compatible version and packed s_savedata size; SDL device enumeration is not a stable host identity.

notes: Source-backed paths are recorded for native desktop builds. Runtime activation, selected binary version, and effective gameplay input remain unverified.
